annotations.text:
Replaces the Replay tab.

The whole drive stays on the map; the selected segment is lit and capped, everything else recedes. Prev/next and the rail below step through segments — try them, this artboard is live.

The rail's bar widths are proportional to segment distance, so it doubles as a shape-of-the-drive overview.

Step to segment 6 (Calçada do Sacramento) for the purple-sector state: a stretch you have never driven faster. Panel border, road name, band label and the ★ PB delta all shift to the purple ramp from tokens.md.
At the first and last segment the matching arrow dims to #3A4048 and the hint below reads START OF DRIVE / END OF DRIVE, so the bounds are legible without a disabled-looking control.

Two open questions, wired as tweak chips on the Segments artboard:

• Speed bands — colour the unlit route by speed band, or let it recede to flat grey so only the selection carries colour.

• Rail — keep the proportional segment rail, or drop it for a cleaner panel.
